author: Nelev
body:
Adds the first tests and the first CI the repository has had. 59 tests, no database and no `.env` required, running in under a second.

## Two real bugs found while writing them

**`MessageRequest` accepted whitespace-only input.** The field comment said `min_length=1` stopped a blank body reaching the pipeline as an empty prompt. It did not — `" "` is one character:

| input | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `""` | rejected | rejected |
| `" "` | **accepted** | rejected |
| `"\t\n"` | **accepted** | rejected |
| `" "` | **accepted** | rejected |

`str_strip_whitespace` runs before the length check, so `min_length` now sees the stripped value. This also normalises accepted input: `"  hi  "` is stored as `"hi"`. Verified as a 422 over HTTP, not just on the model.

**`rag_pipeline` could not be imported as a package.** `embeddings.py` and `run.py` imported siblings flat (`from const import ...`), which only resolves when the file is run by path. Nothing outside the directory could import them, tests included. The entrypoint is now `uv run python -m rag_pipeline.run`.

## Test layout

| Module | What it pins |
|---|---|
| `test_chunks.py` | id uniqueness, the patient prefix every chunk needs to stand alone in retrieval, Chroma-legal metadata scalars, `.get()` vs `[]` (absent sections empty, absent identity loud) |
| `test_settings.py` | DSN components, reserved-character escaping, `SecretStr` keeping the password out of `repr` and rendered DSNs |
| `test_schema.py` | the blank-input cases above, plus extras being ignored |
| `test_main.py` | routes over `httpx.ASGITransport` |
| `test_database.py` | engine idempotency, disposal, session rollback |

Two choices worth flagging for review:

- **`ASGITransport`, not `TestClient`.** `TestClient` runs the lifespan, which calls `init_engine()` and executes `SELECT 1` — every route test would need live Postgres. `ASGITransport` skips lifespan events.
- **No `.env` dependency.** Settings construction passes `_env_file=None` throughout, so results don't vary with an untracked file. Verified by stashing `.env` and running the suite with `DATABASE_PASSWORD` unset.

## Known gap, recorded rather than hidden

`test_duplicate_icd10_does_not_collide` is `xfail(strict=True)`. Episode and pathology chunk ids derive from source fields (`episode_id`, `icd10`) rather than position, so duplicates collide — and because ingest uses `upsert`, the later record silently replaces the earlier one and the corpus loses a chunk with no error. Allergies and medications use `enumerate` and are collision-proof.

Left open deliberately: the fix is either raising or disambiguating with an index, and that is a product call. `strict=True` means the suite fails once it is fixed, so this cannot rot into a permanently ignored test.

## CI

Lint, format check and tests on `ubuntu-latest`. `uv sync --locked` catches a dependency added without relocking. Paths are filtered to `medas-api` — if this becomes a required check, that filter needs a skip-job companion or UI-only PRs will wait forever for a run that never starts.

This PR is the first thing the workflow will run on, so its own result is the verification.
